subsystem: apps/admin-web coach review lab (portal + data layer + dev API)
method: Vitest against the real validators/data layer plus endpoint-level tests against the REAL dev-API middleware (extracted from vite.config.ts into src/coachReview/labApi.ts and mounted unchanged), pointed at a throwaway tmpdir root with a clearly-labeled TEST-ONLY registry. No real-coach reviews were seeded anywhere; the repo's human-managed coaches.json remains empty and untouched; held-out cases wm-dink-01 / afn-vic-rally1 untouched.

breaks.found: validateReview accepted NaN/Infinity for confidence and NaN region coordinates (range checks like `v < 0 || v > 1` are false for NaN). JSON cannot carry NaN, but in-process callers (form logic, amendments embedding reviews) can.
breaks.fix: validate.ts now requires Number.isFinite for confidence and region {x,y,w,h}.

breaks.found: validateAdjudication accepted reviewedReviewIds = [r1, r1]: one review duplicated passed the ≥2 length check, so an adjudication could be recorded with only ONE review actually present.
tests: redteam.test.ts: rejects the same reviewId listed twice
labApi.test.ts: rejects an adjudication with only ONE review present / duplicated ids (HTTP 422)

breaks.found: An adjudication for item X could cite a persisted review of item Y in reviewedReviewIds — it existed and had a different reviewer, so all checks passed; the ≥2-reviews requirement could be satisfied by borrowing reviews from other items.
breaks.fix: labApi.ts builds reviewId→queueItemId from the persisted reviews and validateAdjudication rejects any reviewed review that does not belong to the adjudicated item.
tests: redteam.test.ts: rejects a reviewedReviewId belonging to a different queue item
labApi.test.ts: rejects a reviewedReviewId that belongs to a DIFFERENT queue item (HTTP 422)

breaks.found: ReviewsPanel gated review CONTENT behind canSeeOtherReviews, but AgreementView showed per-item agreement rates, mismatch details and included in-progress items' reviews in the cross-item kappas. With n=2 targets, a coach who knows their own answers can reconstruct the other coach's in-progress review from the aggregates.
breaks.fix: blind.ts adds isBlindInProgress; AgreementView withholds all review-derived metric cells and the adjudication editor for items still collecting real reviews, and excludes those items' real reviews from the pair-kappa inputs (synthetic dev fixtures unaffected).

breaks.found: AgreementView computed agreement and kappa from the original revision-1 reviews even when append-only amendments superseded them, so metrics could contradict the coaches' current judgments (export already used latest revisions — the two surfaces disagreed).
breaks.fix: data.ts adds latestReviewVersions(reviews, amendments); AgreementView resolves reviews through it before computing agreement/kappa.

breaks.found: The entire write-gate middleware lived inline in vite.config.ts, untested; and all non-review POST endpoints (adjudications, amendments, assignments, drill mappings) returned HTTP 500 on malformed JSON bodies instead of 400.
breaks.fix: Middleware extracted verbatim into src/coachReview/labApi.ts (vite.config.ts mounts it unchanged) and all POST bodies parse through a shared readJsonBody that answers 400. 14 endpoint tests now run against the real middleware.

breaks.found: Probed kappa with n=1 and all-same labels, export with zero reviews/adjudications, duplicate review submission, nonexistent queue item/event, unprovisioned coach, credential mismatch, impostor amendment, revision skip. All already behaved correctly (nulls, empty export, 409/422/403) — no defect; pinned as regression tests so they stay correct.
breaks.fix: Regression tests only (no code change needed).
tests: portal.test.ts (pre-existing): export empty with zero adjudications

verification.tests: apps/admin-web: 7 files, 74 tests passed (was 5 files / 50 before this workstream)
verification.no_data_pollution: git status clean under datasets/ after test runs; endpoint tests write only under a tmpdir root that is removed in afterAll

notes: No real coach, Mac, or iPhone evidence exists or is claimed. The production registry remains empty, so every real write path still refuses with 403 until a human provisions a coach per docs/COACHING.md.
